name: Visual novel: Dashing 90s
source:
Andrey is an ordinary prospective student from the provinces. His goal is simple: to enroll in a polytechnic institute and start a new life. But temporary housing in a communal apartment becomes the main test. Here, each neighbor has their own truth, their own interests, and their own ways of surviving.

Speculator Ninka returns from Turkey with contraband and offers quick money for one favor. Alcoholic Kolya asks to go get vodka, hinting that refusal will be costly. Actress Larisa invites him to a midnight cemetery for a "ritual." An old friend, Kostyan, offers to drive his car, supposedly legally. A stranger asks to be escorted through a dark archway. And Kostya, nicknamed Turnip, the neighbor's son, returns from prison. He believes he is the only one in charge in this apartment. Every day, Andrei makes a choice: agree and receive money, connections, and support—but risk his freedom and life. Or refuse and be left alone to face hostility, suspicion, and threats. One agreement can lead to prison, the hospital, or the grave. One refusal can make him an outcast, but leave a chance to pass his exams.

The story branches into dozens of endings: from successful admission to a maximum-security prison colony. The atmosphere of 1990s communal life, the criminal underworld, moral dilemmas, and the cost of every decision—all of this determines the protagonist's fate.

Will Andrei be able to overcome these trials and preserve himself?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4584060]Steam[/url]]
translation:
安德烈是一名来自外省的普通准学生。他的目标很简单：考入理工学院，开始新的生活。但公共公寓的临时住房成为主要考验。在这里，每个邻居都有自己的真理、自己的利益、自己的生存方式。

投机者宁卡带着违禁品从土耳其回来，并提供快钱以换取一个好处。酗酒的科利亚要求去买伏特加，并暗示拒绝将付出高昂的代价。女演员拉丽莎邀请他去午夜墓地参加“仪式”。一位老朋友科斯特扬主动提出驾驶他的车，据说是合法的。一名陌生人要求有人护送他穿过黑暗的拱门。克斯特亚（Kostya），绰号“萝卜”，是邻居的儿子，从监狱回来了。他相信他是这间公寓里唯一的负责人。安德烈每天都会做出选择：同意并获得金钱、关系和支持，但要冒着自由和生命危险。或者拒绝并独自面对敌意、怀疑和威胁。一项协议可能导致入狱、入院或坟墓。一次拒绝可能会让他被抛弃，但却留下了通过考试的机会。

故事分为数十个结局：从成功进入监狱到戒备森严的监狱。20世纪90年代的社会生活氛围、黑社会的犯罪、道德困境以及每一个决定的代价——这一切都决定了主人公的命运。

安德烈能否克服这些考验并保全自己？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4584060]Steam[/url]]
